## Setup

```{r}
#| echo: true

# Install tidyverse if not already installed
if (!requireNamespace("tidyverse", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("tidyverse")
}
library(tidyverse)

# Install and load nycflights13 for flight data
if (!requireNamespace("nycflights13", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("nycflights13")
}
library(nycflights13)
```

## Questions

### 1. Displaying flights dataset

```{r}
library(dplyr)
dplyr::glimpse(flights)
```

### 2. A rewrite of code using dplyr and the pipe

```{r}
#| echo: true

flights1 <- flights |> filter(month == 1)
carrier_vec <- flights1 |> distinct(carrier) |> pull(carrier)
carrier_dist_vec_mean <- numeric(length(carrier_vec))
carrier_dist_vec_sd <- numeric(length(carrier_vec))

for (i in seq_along(carrier_vec)) {
  carrier_data <- flights1 |> filter(carrier == carrier_vec[i])
  carrier_dist_vec_mean[i] <- carrier_data |> summarize(mean_dist = mean(distance)) |> pull(mean_dist)
  carrier_dist_vec_sd[i] <- carrier_data |> summarize(sd_dist = sd(distance)) |> pull(sd_dist)
}
  dist_tbl <- tibble(
  carrier = carrier_vec,
  mean_distance = carrier_dist_vec_mean,
  sd_distance = carrier_dist_vec_sd
)
  dist_tbl |> arrange(mean_distance)
  
```

### 3. Explanation of the NA and 0 standard deviations

It could be the case that the "OO" carrier had only 1 observation, making the standard deviation calculation undefined, hence NA. The other carrier, 'YV', might have all the distances equal.

#### R code for confirmation

```{r}
#| echo: true

flights1 |> filter(carrier == "OO")  

flights1 |> filter(carrier == "YV")|> pull(distance)

```

#### R code for demonstration

```{r}

#| echo: true

sd(c(8)) #should yield NA
sd(c(8,8,8,8)) #should yield 0
```

### 4. Question 4

```{r}
#| echo: true

carrier_month_delay <- flights |>
  group_by(month, carrier) |>
  summarise(avg_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = carrier, values_from = avg_dep_delay)

carrier_month_delay

```

### 5. Question 5

```{r}
#| echo: true

on_time_after_delay <- flights |>
  summarise(
    prop_delayed_on_time = mean(dep_delay > 0 & arr_delay <= 0)
  )

on_time_after_delay

```
